battery.check.title: Check battery
battery.check.desc: The trackpad reports its level over Bluetooth only.
battery.auto.title: Check automatically
battery.auto.desc: Runs in the background so alerts arrive without opening this window.
battery.btonly: Battery can only be read over Bluetooth
battery.est.none: Estimate appears after a few hours of readings
battery.history.empty: History fills in as the app records readings.
mon.disc.title: Trackpad not responding
mon.disc.text: Battery checks failed three times. The trackpad may be off or disconnected.
msg.low: Your Magic Trackpad is at {level}%. Plug it in soon.
msg.crit: Only {level}% left on your Magic Trackpad. Charge it now.
tp.preset.title: Preset
tp.preset.desc: Save the current settings under a name. Presets also appear in the tray menu.
tp.preset.name: Preset name
tp.strength.title: Click strength
tp.strength.desc: How firm the haptic click feels.
tp.silent.title: Silent clicking
tp.silent.desc: Removes the click sound from the haptic motor.
tp.mode.max: Maximum haptic feedback (very clicky and loud)
tp.mode.off: Disable haptics and the force touch button completely
tp.stop.size: Stop the pointer if the touch size is at or below the value
tp.stop.pressure: Stop the pointer if the pressure is at or below the value
tp.stop.hint: A touch size of 7 and a pressure of 0 are good starting values.
tp.ignorebtn.title: Ignore the finger that presses the button
tp.ignorebtn.desc: Helps when you click with your thumb and drag with your index finger.
tp.ignorenear.title: Ignore fingers hovering near the surface
tp.ok.title: Settings applied
tp.ok.msg: The trackpad driver restarted and reloaded them.
tp.err.title: Could not apply settings
nt.alerts.title: Battery alerts
nt.alerts.desc: Show a Windows notification when the trackpad runs low.
nt.low.title: Low battery at
nt.crit.title: Critical battery at
nt.crit.desc: Urgent warning. The tray icon turns red.
nt.repeat.title: Remind me again
nt.repeat.desc: Repeats while the level stays below the low threshold.
nt.disc.title: Tell me if it disconnects
nt.disc.desc: Notify when battery checks fail three times in a row.
nt.placeholder: {level} is replaced with the current percentage.
ap.startup.title: Start with Windows
ap.startup.desc: Runs in the tray at sign-in without a UAC prompt.
ap.tray.title: Keep running in the tray when closed
ap.tray.desc: Needed for battery alerts when this window is closed.
ap.driver.title: Driver
ap.driver.fail: Driver not found (error {0}). Run as administrator and check the driver is installed.
ap.lang.title: Language
ap.lang.desc: Takes effect after you restart the app.
